tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro dang / sor sdud bsam gtan gyi dris lan cung zad/ drung chos kyi rjes mdzad pa bzhugs so// swasti/ bla ma dam pa dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i spyi'i bsnyen pa sngon 'gro'i skabs su/ slob ma'i yon tan gsum zhes smos nas/ tha ma rjes su mi 'dzin par gsal ba'i don/ gang zag gsum smon pa'i tha ma/ bslab pa'i gnas lnga sbyin bya/ dge bsnyen du bsdu yi dngos grub gnyis sbyin bya'i snod min zhes pa'i don no/ /dge 'dun gyi gzugs ni/ rnal 'byor pa dge slong ngam rab byung gi gzugs/ dge bsnyen khyim pa'i gzugs su bsgom/ 'og ma gnyis kyang des 'gre/ maṇḍal ni/ rgyun gyi skabs su/ yig brgya'i rjes la maṇḍal phul kyang chog 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad 'gro ba'i bla ma gong ma'i yin gsung ba tsam las/ bla ma 'di'i yin gsung ba mi gda'/ tri ratna zhes pa/ tri ni gsum/ ratna dkon mchog dang rin chen gyi skad dod thun mong ba yin pas 'dir dkon mchog gsum zhes pa lags/ bar dge'i dben gsum gyi/ nyams sna tshogs 'byung ba'i zhi gnas ci rigs skye zhes pa sems mi g.yo bar gnas pa zhi gnas/ de las gsal snang gi nyams sna tshogs 'byung ba lhag mthong yin nam zhus pas/ sems gsal la rtog pa med par gnas pa zhi gnas yin/ de lhag mthong gi nyams sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas/ nyams sna tshogs 'byung ba'i zhi gnas skye zhes dris pa lags/ de'i rtags kyang lus nyams/ rlung nyams/ sems nyams lnga dang / dngul chu'i gnas skabs lnga dang sbyor ba'i tshul/ nyams dang po rnam rtog ngos zin nam/ dngul chu me'i steng du bzhag ma thag du bar 'gro ba dang 'dra/ nyams gnyis pa sogs kyang des 'dra ba ngo sprod na bdog cing / dngul chu'i gnas skabs lnga zhes pa/ dngul chu rang la dus rgyun du yod pa min yang / dngul chu btul nas gser 'gyur ram/

bcud len gyi rdzas byed pa'i tshe/ mes 'dul dgos la/ de thog mar rkong bur blugs/ mer bcug ma thag du bar byas nas 'bros pa gnas skabs dang po/ de ma bcings na 'bros pas 'ching ba'i rdzas/ rags pa srog rtsol du bris pa kun blugs te bsregs pas 'bros mi nus par/ tsig tsig gi sgra 'byin zhing cung zad 'bros pa gnas skabs gnyis pa/ de nas mi 'bros par 'phar ba gsum pa/ de nas 'phar ba zhi ste 'dar ba bzhi pa/ de ltar 'dar ba dang yang bral nas dngul chu bskams pa lnga pa ste dngul chu dul ba'i tshad yin/ de bzhin du rnam rtog rim gyis zhi ba'i sems nyams lnga/ lus nad rim gyis zhi ba'i gnas skabs lnga lus nyams te/ rnam rtog rim gyis 'gag lus nad rim gyis zhi zhes pa'i don lags/ snang ba nyer thob/ snang ba mched pa/ snang ba'i nyams skyes pa'i mthong snang rim pa bzhin du 'byung zhes pa/ mun pa dwangs su song ste/ sgom khang yangs su song ba/ snang ba nyer thob/ de rting mtha' nas dmar thing 'byung ba snang ba mched pa/ nam langs pa ltar skya sang dwangs pa snang ba/ de nas sprin/ de nas du ba sogs 'byung ba la zer ba lags/ rjes spyod na/ rig pa'i zas yul yid du mi yong ba dang zhes la/ reg pa'i zas zhes brjod pa'i don/ reg pa lus dang phrad pa/ zas zhes pa des rnam shes kyi stobs brtas par byed pa la zer/ bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa gang 'os brtan zhes pa/ rlung la brten pa'i spogs chog 'khrid yig spyi'i bsnyen pa'i spogs chog ces pa de yin la/ lam 'bras/ phyag chen sogs kyi bying rgod sel ba'i gdams ngag rnams kyang lags shing / 'di'i skabs su/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la/ yid rtse gcig tu drag tu gtod pa'i rdor bzlas yin/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba skye dka' na sogs kyi man ngag mnyam rgyu'i dus su/ srog bsdams pa'i bum pa can 'dzin pa'i byed tshul 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin byed pa lags/

sor sdud kyi dus mtshams kyi/ der chud pas/ stong pa nam mkha'i rlung / mtshan ma bcu dang zhes pa/ nam mkha'i rlung dbu mar chud pas/ nyin mtshan gyi rtags bcu 'byung ba yin nam/ de ltar na 'di'i nyams dga'i skabs su/ du ba sogs bzhi 'byung bzhi'i rlung rim bzhin rgyu ba zin pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / nam mkha'i rlung kho nas zin pa la mi 'dod pa 'dra bas gang yin zhes zhus pa'i don/…mtshan ma bcu pa 'byung ba la/ stong pa nam mkha'i rlung dbu mar zin dgos pa la zer/ gzhan rnams sa sogs yi ger bris pa bzhin lags/ 'dug gnas kyi nges pa'i 'khyog sgo 'am 'dzul sgo zhes pa ni 'khyog sgo gsum sgo 'khyog gsum byas pa'i phyi ma rtogs pa la sgo med kyang chog 'dzul sgo mi shong tsam pa/ phyi chung ba/ nang che ba/ sgo nga'i dbyibs ltar brus pa/ nang nas sbod logs kyis bkag pas mun pa thub pa la zer/ byed bcings kyi byed pa dbang po lnga yul la 'jug pa bcing ba srog rlung bcings pas bcings pa yin pas zhes pa/ lta stangs kyi nges pa la gnas pa la zer ram/ rlung 'dzin pa la zer ba lags zhus pas …lus gnad lta stangs bcas pa tsam gyis rlung ngang gis gnas nas rgyu ba shas chung ba 'byung ba la zer/ nang gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs kyi dbu mar srog zin te/ stong gzugs sna tshogs mthong la/ zhes pa dbu mar rlung zin pa rang la 'dod/ nyin gung mtshan gung mi bsgom pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de gnyis bing shas che bas bsgoms kyang skyon can las mi 'byung ba la dgongs par gda'/ nyams rtags kyi nges pa'i skabs kyi dri ba ni/ gur gsang 'dus sogs su/ mtshan rtags la sprin med nam mkha' ste lnga/ mtshan nyid gnyis ka lnga lngar byas/ 'di'i lugs la thig le rtags su mi 'dren par/ rtags can du bzhed/ 'di ka'i lugs la mtshan rtags bzhi/ nyin rtags drug yin zhing / khyed rang gi yi ger thig le'i gong du glog chad par gda'/ 'di'i dus mtshams kyi skabs na rtags bcu rdzogs/

thig le mthong ba ji srid pa'i bar ro zhes pa/ nyin rtags kyi thig le la zer ba lags/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga'i rtog dpyod gnyen po'i yan lag ces pa/ shes rab kyi rtse gcig pa ma gtogs na gnyen por rtog dpyod gnyis bsgoms pas/ gnyen po gces pa/ yang sems rtse gcig tu gnas na/ gzugs kyang mi g.yo mi 'gag par gnas pa na/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag rtog pa la brlabs te zhes pas/ shes rab kyi rtse gcig zin yang rtog pa'i yan lag bsgom dgos par gsal ba dang / spyod pa la 'dod lugs gnyis 'dug pa/ don la shes rab dang khyad med pa'i rtse gcig kho na yin pas 'dra zhing / mdzod las/ rtog dpyod gnyis po rtsing zhib tu 'dod cing / 'di rnams ji ltar yin zhus pas/…stong gzugs mi g.yo ba shes rab yin gyis rtog dpyod min/ stong gzugs mi g.yo ba rang sems yin par shes na dpyod pa logs su sgom mi dgos/ ma shes par mnyam gzhag la'ang da ltar mthong ba bzhin yul yul can tha dad kyi rnam pa 'dug na stong gzugs de rang sems su 'du shes pa mngon du btang nas nang du sems la yid gtod pa yin/ gnyen po zer ba gzung 'dzin tha dad du 'dzin pa'i gnyen po byed pa la zer/ 'grel par/ rtog pa zhes pa dngos po 'dzin pa'o zhes/ phyag rdor stod 'grel du sems kyi dngos po 'dzin pa'o zhes pas mig stong gzugs dang / de ka shes pa'i ngo bo yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang nas yid rang gi sems la gtod pa rtog pa yin/ mkhan chen pa sgom rgyu de ka las mi bzhed/ dpyod pa zhes pa rtog pa bsgoms pas rjes shes su stong gzugs nam mthong ba dang rang sems mthong snyam du dran pa yin gsung / 'on kyang stong gzugs mthong ba'i tshe sems gnas kyang stong gzugs rang sems su ma shes par gzugs sems tha dad du 'dzin pa byung na de'i gnyen por rang sems nyid stong gzugs yin snyam du 'dun pa btang nas rang sems la yid gtad de bsgoms pas goms rtsa na mnyam gzhag tu gzugs sems 'dres nas tha dad du 'dzin pa med par gcig tu 'dres/

de stobs kyis sems gtad pa tsam gyis las snang 'gags nas stong gzugs su 'char ba yin/ nyams rtags kyi nges pa'i skabs kyi thig le yang je phrar gyur te/ re khā'i nang du 'char la/ de rnams dag nas/ dus kyi rtsa'i nang du mthong zhing zhes pa'i/ re khā zhes pa spu shad kyi rnam pa lta bu/ nag po nar mo 'byung ba la zer/ gug po'ang yong gin yod par gda'/ gang ltar yang / spu nag po 'dra ba la zer/ khyed rang gi la dus rgyun du yong zer ba de'ang / sgra gcan ma yin/ re khā'i nang du thig le shar ba de yin/ rgyun du yong ba yang rtags mchog yin/ dus kyi rtsa a wa dhū ti yin/ mig gi mchog gi gzugs dang bskal pa'i don/ zhes pa mchog sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i gzugs la sogs pa yin la/ bskal pa'i don zhes pa/ rang re tha mal pas thabs la ma brten par shes mi nus pa'i don yin la/ bskal pa'i sgra yang mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid kyi sgra 'byung ba la zer ba lags/ spyod lam gyi skabs na mun khang chung ngu zhes pa/ mig btsums pa yin/ spogs chog gi/ g.yon rgyu'i dus su sna g.yon rgyu'i sdom sor zhes pa/ smin mtshams na rtsa chen gsum ka'i yar sna gzhibs nas yod pa'i g.yon pa la gtod pa yin/ bar dge'i srog rtsol gyi sgra don ni/ srog steng 'og gi rtsa chen drug la rgyu ba'i srog thur gyi rlung yin la zhes ni/ steng na rtsa gsum/ de la rgyu ba'i rlung srog 'og gi rtsa gsum la rgyu ba'i rlung thur sel yin/ lta stangs kyi nges pa na/ gtong ba na smin dbus kyi nam mkha'/ rngub pa'i tshe rtsa g.yon gyi sgo/ dgang ba'i tshe rtsa g.yas kyi sgo/ gzhil ba'i tshe smin dbus su lta ba'am zhes pa/ khyed rang gi 'dod pa bkod pa bzhin yin pas/ gtong ba phyir 'byung / smin dbus kyi nam mkha' la/ rngub pa nang 'jug rtsa g.yon gyi sgo smin phrag na yod pa la/ dgang ba nang du gnas pa'i tshe/

rtsa g.yas kyi sgo smin phrag na yod pa la/ gzhil ba phyir 'byung smin dbus su lta bas te/ mdor na rlung rgyu thebs gcig gi/ gtong rngub dgang gzhil bzhi la sems gtod pa re mos byed pa de ka lags/ yang sku'i tshe rtsa sgo g.yon zhes sogs kyi don/ sku gsung thugs kyi rlung gsum sa rlung lte ba'i bar/ chu rlung sor gcig gi nang du thung / phyir ring / de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang bsgre/ byed bcings kyi skabs su/ mig yid gcig tu dril nas rlung la gtod ces pa mig dang yid/ rlung rang la gtod pa yin gyi/ rtsa sgo rnams su ma yin/ nyams len gyi skabs na/ sgra med par 'jam pos zlos pa nyid mchog tu bzhed do zhes pa/ man ngag rigs pa'i bla ma rnams kyang bzhed cing / rgyud sdom 'byung nas gsungs pa yin/ rlung gi rgyu ba gsal bar ma mthong nas/ man ngag bya ba'i skabs de/ sa rlung rgyu ba'i dus kyi tshe/ rdo rje'i stabs dang gdan/ gzhan gsum po'ang des 'dre/ dngos gzhi ma ning gi bzlas pa ni/ dung can ma 'ba' zhig la sngar ltar gtad nas bsgom pa'o/ /zhes pa'i byed tshul khyed rang gi de ma nges pa yin la/ dpon 'bras mo zer ba bzhin steng rlung la byed pa ma yin zhing / dung can ma dang / bshang sgo gnyis po 'byung 'jug gnas gsum byed pa de ka lags/ 'gal rkyen spang tshul gyi skabs na/ lci ba'i rlung drag tu zla zhes pa'i don/ steng rlung dang bshang sgo rang sor bzhag gci ba'i sgo kho na sdom glod drag tu byed pa yin/ snying mgrin gyi bum pa can sogs kyi don/ lus gnad bcas la/ thog mar bud/ de nas rlung mgrin par sleb pa dang / kos ko dgu byas nas 'dzin/ snying kha'i bum pa can rlung snying khar sleb pa dang / sked pa gdeng / brang dgye byas nas thub tshad 'dzin/ 'di rnams la 'og rlung 'dzin mi 'tshal/ 'di dag kyang / nad zhi ba nas gong du mi bya la zhes pa'i don/ gegs sel 'di rnams gegs de sangs pa nas rlung sbyor 'phro gcod pa yin la/

'phro ma bcad na slar nyes pa bskyed pa'i skyon yod ces pa'o/ /dpral bar rlung 'gags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod cing bsngags pa byed la zhes pa/ dpral bar rlung 'gags pas/ phyi rol du byang sems kyis mchod pa'i snang ba 'byung ba la zer/ 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi/ mchil ma sgra med du mid nas/ spyi bor phul la/ de'i gzugs spyi bor mthong ba la zhes pa'i don/ mchil ma sgra med du mid/ kha btsums nas/ phyir rgyu ba dang / mgrin pa man la mi gnon par/ rlung phyir bcud pa ltar byas te yar 'phul ba yin/…de'i gzugs spyi bor mthong ba la zhes pa'i don de'i lan ma tshud 'dug pas da bzod zhu dgos/ gegs bsal ba'i skabs na/ rang ngam gzhan gyis a wa dhū tī'i phyag rgya la brten nas zhes pa/ dhū tī'i phyag rgya tshangs spyod pa'i las phyag tu bshad pa de yin/ gong du 'pho ba'i skabs kyis/ lte ba'i bum pa can drag tu bzung ste/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba byas pas zhes pa/ u rgyan pa'i de ma lags shing / rlung bzung nas/ mgrin pa'i rtsa gnyis po sdom pa a mar ra'i sbyor ba de lags/ las tshogs bsgrubs pa'i skabs kyi de/ las tshogs sgrub gong du bstan nas/ de nas zad par bsgrub bya yod pas/ de gnyis mi gcig par bdog 'di'i khrid kyi skabs min par/ rdor bzlas kyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i thabs dang bar chad rnams sel bar byed pa'i man ngag bya tshul lam 'bras bzhin nam spyir 'gro'i tshul du nyams su len pa ni/ thog mar sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro'i nyams len bzhin nam/ lam 'bras bzhin gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / gdon gyi bar chad sel ba la byams snying rje la nan tan bskyed cing / yi dam gyi lha cung zad bsgom/ bar chad sel ba la khro bo mchog yin/ rkang pa sems dpa'i skyil krung la sogs lus gnad/ rlung gi drangs 'dzin na/

lag pa gcig gis phreng ba skyur/ gcig pus mo la 'gebs pa'am/ lus gnad kyi bskyon du mi 'gro ba'i lugs kyis gang bder gnas pas chog la/ rlung ro bsal nas/ dang po rtsom pa na srog nas rgyu ba nas bzung ste/ nang 'jug nas mgo 'dzin/ de la nang du rgyu ba oṃ/ gnas pa āḥphyir 'gro ba hūm̐ zhes yid rlung rtse gcig tu ma g.yengs par zla/ de la sems gnas pa na/ de brtan pa'i yan lag tu srog la sngan dgas rim gyis byin zer ba nang 'jug je ring du/ nang du gnas phyir 'gro je thung btang la/ de dang mthun par yid kyis kyang / nang du ring du rgyus/ nang du gnas/ phyir thung du rgyus shes dran par byas te/ 'dis nang du yun ring du gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar gsungs/ lam 'bras pa'i man ngag de ltar yin/ don gyis/ phyi nang gang du'ang rlung phyed du mi 'dzin/ ring du'ang mi gtong bar rang 'gros de ka la yid rlung rtse gcig tu bzlas pas/ cung zad 'byongs nas nang du rgyu ba dang gnas pa je ring la 'gro ba la sems gnas pa de kas khyab pa lags/ 'phro gcod pa na rlung sems kyi rtsol ba glod la/ lta khrid kyi skabs ltar/ chos gsum gyi lta ba bskyangs pas/ ting nge 'dzin mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /…gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid la sems gzung ba ni/ phyi nang gang la bltas kyang gsal ba'i ngo bor ma 'gags par 'dug pa de la cher bltas nas/ de'i ngang la rtog pa med par 'jog pa lags/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin la sems gzung ba ni phyi nang gang la bltas kyang rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ gnas ba'i lus phyi nang na'ang mi 'dug la phyi nang na'ang mi 'dug dbyings la bltas na de na'ang mi 'dug la/ des na rang bzhin stong par 'dug pa de'i ngang la cher rtse bltas na rtog med kyi ngang la 'jig pa yin/ bcos min sems kyi ngo bo la sems gzung ba ni/ de ltar mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe na/

gsal rig ma 'gag pa'i dus nyid na stong / stong dus nyid na gsal bas gsal stong gi ngo bo nyid nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu de la ma bcos par lhod kyis glod/ rtsen gyis 'jog pa yin/ 'di lam 'bras pa'i lugs kyis lta ba rnam par dag pa'i tshul yin/ rlung nang du gnas pa lte ba dang / phyir sor bcu gnyis tsam du yid gtod pa byas na dmigs pa 'dzin pa sla zhing btub mod/ 'on kyang / rlung lnga po phyi nang du rgyu ba'i ring thung 'khrid yig bzhin gsal na dga'/ rdor bzlas yun ring du song dus 'dis drod skyed pas/ drod 'phel drags par gyur pa na/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe sna nas btang ngo / /nang du yong ba'i tshe sna la yong du mi gzhug par so bar nas/ si'i sgra dang bcas pas 'dren pa yin/ yi ge gsum dang spel nas bzla ba bskyed rim gyi char gtogs rlung kho na la yid gtod pa 'di/ nges don kho na yin/ de ltar rdor bzlas 'di ting nge 'dzin skye ba/ bar chad sel ba/ tshe sring ba la sogs kyi thabs mchog tu rgyud sde thams cad dang / man ngag thams cad nas 'byung ba lags shing / 'di ka las gzhan pa'i bar chad srung thabs gzhan mi 'tshal/ 'di ka la brtson pas khyab/ rdor bzlas byed tshul sbyor drug bzhin gyi rjes la/ lam 'bras bzhin byas na bogs 'don bzhin du 'gyur/ 'di'i dus su khams 'dzag pa bsrung dgos pa'i don/ rlung dang thig le bsrung nus na/ bar chad kyi rigs thams cad thub par nges pas kyang thob pa lags/ rdor bzlas rlung kho na la yid 'dzin pa de/ dus 'khor rang gi dgongs pa'ang yin/ sngags dang spel nas bzlas pa yang / de nas gsung / aṣṭa la byed tshul gzhan med/ gnam gdon srung sel la/ rdor bzlas kyis kyang shin tu phan mod na'ang / gtso cher kha sang gi gdams ngag de ka zab kyin 'dug sa gdon sel ba la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed khyad par byams snying rje yi dam bsgom pa cis kyang sngon du btang /

rdor bzlas rang bzhin pa 'dis kyang drod skyed pa dang / gzhi de'ang drod yin pas de ltar drod ches na gong bzhin bya/ byang sems ye mi nyams par bya bar dus 'khor nas bshad/ phrin las so gnyis rim rim min dgu bcu drug po rgyun du byed/ sa skyar 'di kho na byas pas nad thon pa byung / thun mtshams su chu gtor gtong ba dang / bsngo ba bya/ yang zhi sogs kyi las bsgrub tshul/ rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa khrid yig na gsal po bdog 'bras mo pa'i kha sing gi sgra snyan gyi rnam pa de la'ang 'di byas rgyun du tshe dpag med kyang byas na dga' bas bskul/ gong du smos pa'i don rags rim ngo sprod du bris bdog cing / rgya che bar rgyud sde rnams dang / khyad par du/ dus 'khor sems 'grel rnams las gsal bar 'byung bas/ de dag gi tshig don la 'dris par bya ba dang / de dag gi don brtson pas nyams su blangs pa las rtogs par 'gyur bas/ spyan snga ba la'ang de bzhin du snyan bskul ba dang / nyi cag kyang de bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ spyan snga ba'i mtshan gyi sgra sgrogs gsum ka btub par gda' na'ang / 'jam dbyangs dang mi g.yo ba gang mos la mdzod/ rgyun gyi bskyed bzlas gshin rje'i gshed pas/ spyir gyis kyang byin rlabs myur zhing / bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam yang yin pas bde mchog ka 'thad/ 'di la zhi khro gang byas kyang chog cing / gnyis ka'ang yin a ra pa tsa na'i ma sha'i sbyor ba byed tshul 'jam dkar dang 'dra/ dhīḥ'i 'od kyi dmigs pa snying kha'i de la byed cing / gnyis ka la gsal na gnyis ka la bzung bas khyab la/ ral gri 'dzin tshul blo la gang bde byas pas chog 'di yi bar chad sel ba'i mi g.yo ba sngon po yin zhing / rjes la dhīḥ'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa/ rje pa dang / chos rje pa gang mos kyi lugs su byas pas khyab/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshar gsum khug pa zhes pa ni/ tshar gsum ni go sla zhing / khug pa zhes pa 'phro mi gcod par rgyun gcig po de la gsum ga byed zer ba'i tshig yin pas/

skud pa gcig khug pa gsum byed pa la 'phro ma bcad pa dgos pa bzhin lags/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid lam 'bras kyi rjes la mi bton par zur du byed na/ yig brgya'i khrid byed pa shin tu'ang 'thad/ chos rje pa dang / dam pa rgya gar rmi lam du mjal ba chos re nyan pa rmis na'ang / tshig 'bru ma dran par gda'/ dor zhag spyan snga ba sku mtshams mdzad nas nyams myong skyong ba shin tu legs shing / khyed kyis kyang 'phral du gsos 'debs pa dang / stabs bde na bla ma dpal seng ba de thos pa dang nyams myong 'brel ba gcig 'dug pa dang / rin po che pa rang dang 'dris po 'dug pas/ nyams bsdur dang gsal 'debs byas na dga' ba gcig mchi/ lū hi pa'i dkyil chog rje pa'i de las 'don pa dpod pa yin pas yig cha gzhan cher mi dgos na'ang / dā ri ka pa'i dkyil chog de byung na dga' bas sring / sbyor drug gi ngo sprod 'phro de ci myur du byas nas 'bul ba la bskur ba yin zer ba zhus mdzod/ zab mo'i lam la gnad kyi dri ba 'di/ /ring na gnas kyang nye ba'i bsam pa can/ /theg pa mchog gi bshes gnyen yar lung pa/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan lhag bsam dge ba yis/ nye bar bskul nas bsod nams kyis smras pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro kun phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rtag brten te/ /myur du dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnas thob shog/ //shubhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 bla ma dam pa/ sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro dang sor sdud bsam gtan gyi dris lan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
